Here, a thank-you from the town. I don't think anyone will dig those bones again.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_tide_cave.summ: A rumour from the Shiomori guide: an octopus in the Tide Cave tears the fishing nets. Go and see.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_tide_cave.done: An octopus with a shell on its back lived in the cave. The guide will tell the fishers they can put their nets back.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_tide_cave.go.j: North on the beach, a rock mouth leads to a cave the tide floods. An octopus wearing a shell tears the nets at night.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_tide_cave.clea: The master at the very back. Mind the tide. Suggested Lv 16.
Defeat the master of the Tide Cave
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_tide_cave.back: The master is down. Tell the guide.
Report the master of the Tide Cave

There's a cave on the north beach that the tide floods.
An octopus with a shell on its back tears the nets at night. The fishers are at their wits' end. If you can reach the back, go and see.

The octopus? ...Good, the nets can go back out.
This is from the fishers. Come back when the tide's out.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_storm_hollow.s: A rumour from the Kazemachi guide: something makes the crystal cave ring. Go and see.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_storm_hollow.d: A lizard with storm crystals on its back lived in the cave. The guide says it won't ring at night any more.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_storm_hollow.g: North of the village, past a rock mouth, a crystal cave rings every night. A lizard with storm crystals on its back is said to live there.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_storm_hollow.c: The master at the very back. It lets out lightning when its crystals fill. Suggested Lv 22.
Defeat the master of the Stormcrystal Hollow
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_storm_hollow.b: The master is down. Tell the guide.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_town_guide_storm: Report the master of the Stormcrystal Hollow

Past the rock mouth to the north there's a crystal cave. It rings at night.
They say a big lizard with storm crystals on its back lives there. The old folk said hitting the crystals with skills moves the doors.

The cave's gone quiet. ...That was you, wasn't it.
Here, a thank-you from the village. I think I'll sleep well tonight.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_molten_mine.ti: The Forge That Never Goes Out
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_molten_mine.su: A rumour from the Hairo guide: a giant with a forge on its back still works the old mine. Go and see.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_molten_mine.do: A giant carrying a forge lived at the bottom. The guide says the Ashfolk's mine has finally gone cold.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_molten_mine.go: East of town, past a rock mouth, lies the Ashfolk's old mine. A giant carrying a forge is said to still be swinging its hammer.
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_molten_mine.cl: The master at the very bottom. Wait for the lava to shift. Suggested Lv 28.
Defeat the master of the Molten Mine
quest.skyabyss.town.rumor_molten_mine.ba: The master is down. Tell the guide.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_town_guide_ember: Report the master of the Molten Mine

Past the rock mouth to the east is the Ashfolk's old mine.
They say a giant with a forge on its back is still swinging its hammer. The lava changes its course now and then, so be patient.

The giant's forge went out? ...The Ashfolk's mine is finally asleep.
Here, a thank-you from the town. It must have been hot down there.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_pilgrim.title: To the Mossy Wayshrine
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_pilgrim.summary: An old pilgrim asked you to stack one pebble at the mossy wayshrine to the east.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_pilgrim.done: You added one more pebble to the wayshrine. The old man rubbed his knees and laughed.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_pilgrim.idl: I walk the shrines as far as the city bell can be heard. When I can't hear it, I turn back.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_pilgrim.aft: My knees feel a little better. Maybe the wayshrine already heard us.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_pilgrim.q_a:
Forty years I've walked from shrine to shrine. But my knees won't let me past this camp.
Would you go to the mossy wayshrine just east of here? Stack one pebble for me.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_pilgrim.q_w: The wayshrine to the east. When you see a hill of pebbles, that's it.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_pilgrim.q_b: Tell him the pebble is stacked
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_pilgrim.q_d:
Good, good. The wayshrine's a pebble taller now.
They say a wish comes true for each one who stacks. I wished one for you too.
Take this. What's left of my road money. My journey only needs walking now.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_pilgrim.go.jour: The mossy wayshrine to the east. Stack one pebble for the old pilgrim.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_pilgrim.back.jo: The pebble is stacked. Tell the old pilgrim.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_pilgrim.go.go: Go to the mossy wayshrine (east of the camp)
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_minstrel.title: The Music Box
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_minstrel.summar: A minstrel asked you to find her music box in the boat washed up on the east beach.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_minstrel.done: The music box was dry. The minstrel held it to her chest without opening it.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_minstrel.id: Singing at Tidekeep earns a little road money. But without my music box I only remember half of each song.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_minstrel.af: I opened the box last night. One song came out and went east... the way you are going.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_minstrel.q_:
Our boat capsized crossing the inland sea. Only I washed up on this beach.
My music box should be near the boat on the east beach. Before the songs inside melt into the tide... would you look?
The east beach. The boat's probably upside down. The box sings when you tap it.

Oh, thank goodness. It's dry.
I'll open it on a quiet-tide night. The song only comes out once.
This is for you. It's no song, but still.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_minstrel.go.jou: The boat washed up on the east beach. The music box should be there; it sings when tapped.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_minstrel.back.j: You found the music box. Bring it to the minstrel.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_minstrel.back.b: Bring the music box to the minstrel
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_minstrel.go.go: Find the minstrel's boat (east beach from the camp)
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_mapmaker.title: The Blank Map
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_mapmaker.summar: A mapmaker asked you to look at the One-Night Fort and the Split Gate.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_mapmaker.done: Two blank spots on the map were filled. The mapmaker set down the brush and was quiet a while.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_mapmaker.id: Blank spots on a map unsettle me. I can't tell if I want to fill them or not.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_mapmaker.af: The map is done. I left one blank spot. Around the abyss. I feel I shouldn't draw it.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_camp_mapmaker.q_:
I'm drawing a map of the Ash Wilds. But the ash is deep here, and the fort and gate are too far for my feet.
The One-Night Fort to the east, and the Split Gate past it. Go, and tell me their shapes. Then I can draw them.
The fort is east, the gate southeast past it. Both.

The fort still stands burnt. The gate is split. ...Just as I drew them.
I think I knew before I drew. The Ash Wilds haven't changed from the old maps at all. Burnt out, and stopped.
Take this. Money from selling copies of the map.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_mapmaker.go.jou: The blank spots on the map: the One-Night Fort to the east and the Split Gate southeast past it.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_mapmaker.back.j: You saw the fort and the gate. Tell the mapmaker.
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_mapmaker.back.b: Tell the mapmaker what you saw
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_mapmaker.go.for: Look at the One-Night Fort (east of the camp)
quest.skyabyss.town.camp_mapmaker.go.gat: Look at the Split Gate (southeast past the fort)
